title: DeepUnfolding_Agent: A Classical_Quantum Adaptive Control API
abstract: arXiv:2610.20615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptive optimization workflows in machine learning, federated learning, quantum machine learning, and hybrid classical quantum systems often embed controller logic directly inside task specific training scripts. This coupling limits reuse, reproducibility, safety validation, and fair comparison across execution environments. This paper presents DeepUnfolding Agent, a schema-driven FastAPI platform that exposes deep unfolded adaptive control as an external software service. External executors register a strategy schema, submit round-level diagnostic variables, receive schema-bounded control actions, execute one optimization round, and return feedback for controller update. The framework separates controller intelligence from domain specific execution through a strategy registry, diagnostic to state adapter, controller factory, safety guard, executor abstraction, feedback update path, SQLite persistence layer, Docker deployment, and repro

translated_title: DeepUnfolding_Agent：一个经典-量子自适应控制API
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.20615v1 Announce Type: new 摘要：机器学习、联邦学习、量子机器学习以及混合经典-量子系统中的自适应优化工作流通常将控制器逻辑直接嵌入到特定任务的训练脚本中。这种耦合方式限制了复用性、可重复性、安全性验证以及跨执行环境的公平比较。本文提出了 DeepUnfolding Agent，一个基于模式驱动的 FastAPI 平台，将深度展开的自适应控制以外部软件服务的形式提供。外部执行器注册策略模式、提交轮次级别的诊断变量、接收受模式约束的控制动作、执行一轮优化，并返回反馈用于控制器更新。该框架通过策略注册表、诊断到状态的适配器、控制器工厂、安全防护机制、执行器抽象、反馈更新路径、SQLite 持久化层、Docker 部署以及可重复性支持，将控制器智能与特定领域的执行过程分离开来。
tldr: 本文提出 DeepUnfolding Agent，一个基于模式驱动的 FastAPI 平台，将深度展开的自适应控制作为外部软件服务从特定领域执行中解耦出来，从而提升自适应优化工作流在机器学习、联邦学习和量子系统中的复用性、可重复性与安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DeepUnfolding Agent, a schema-driven FastAPI platform that exposes deep unfolded adaptive control as an external software service decoupled from domain-specific execution, enhancing reusability, reproducibility, and safety of adaptive optimization workflows across machine learning, federated learning, and quantum systems.
